name: GPU Vertex Shader Isosurface Extraction
definition: A technique to compute isosurfaces on GPUs by drawing a single quadrilateral for each tetrahedron and computing intersections in the vertex shader.
summary: GPU Vertex Shader Isosurface Extraction tessellates large unstructured tetrahedral grids by storing data in textures and using vertex texture lookups to avoid redundant geometry, enabling efficient processing of millions of tetrahedra.
